findings.scopeLimit: main currently allocates a fresh report directory, preventing ordinary reuse. Fix the helper precondition to uphold the documented crashed-command rejection and protect future callers.

limitations: Supporting inventory only; no real application adapter is enabled.
--require-golden still raises unconditionally; supported pass cannot close golden acceptance.
